text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the championship tournament 
concluded, <chrname>'s fan base expanded greatly 
thanks to the event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The U.A.F. had become another stage where 
Umamusume could truly shine. And then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The announcement was made for the 2nd 
tournament. This time, it would be on an 
even grander scale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate entertainment where every 
Umamusume shines as an athlete— The 
"U.A.F." continues to expand their 
potential.
